# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Linux native asset realignment**

## Highlights

Upcoming packages no longer include Linux x86 native assets.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move Linux deployments off x86** — Linux x86 native builds and NuGet package entries have been removed. Move 32-bit Linux deployments to a supported architecture before upgrading; applications that still require Linux x86 must retain an earlier package that supplies those assets. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))
